name: Bitsy
description: A little engine for little games, worlds, and stories.

name: Downpour
description: The best way to make games on your phone — collage photos, drawings and text into an interactive story. Quick enough to finish before your tea goes cold.

name: Flickgame
description: A tiny game engine — easy to use, with HTML export. Draw on slides and connect them together.

name: GB Studio
description: A quick and easy drag-and-drop retro game creator for your favourite handheld console.

name: Narrat
description: A beginner-friendly engine for narrative games with RPG features, visual novels and interactive fiction. No coding required — a simple scripting syntax with skills, items, quests and branching choices.

name: PuzzleScript
description: An open-source HTML5 puzzle game engine.

name: Whimtale
description: A small game engine and fantasy console for making interactive stories you can navigate and talk with — narrative-driven exploratory games with no prior experience needed.

name: Wareware
description: (In development) A hot new 3D game maker — build your dream game and finally get on with your life.

name: Libresprite
description: A free, open-source program for creating and animating sprites. Not a game engine — for making game assets.

name: Twine
description: An open-source tool for telling interactive, nonlinear stories. Start with no code, then extend with variables, logic, images, CSS and JavaScript. Publishes straight to HTML and is free for any use, including commercial.

name: Ren'Py
description: A visual novel engine used by thousands of creators to tell interactive stories with words, images and sounds, on desktop and mobile. Open source and free for commercial use.

name: Decker
description: A multimedia platform for creating and sharing interactive documents — with sound, images, hypertext and scripted behavior.

name: Pico-8
description: A fantasy console for making, sharing and playing tiny games. Comes with a commandline, cartridge creation tools and an online cartridge browser called SPLORE.

name: inkly
description: A narrative scripting language for games.

name: Phaser
description: Create amazing 2D games for the web — free, open source and AI-ready.

name: Godot
description: Your free, open-source game engine. Not tiny in itself, but great for tiny games — pick a template project to start.

name: LÖVE
description: An awesome framework for making 2D games in Lua. Free, open-source, and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS.

name: GameMaker
description: A complete development tool for making 2D games — used by indie devs, studios and educators worldwide, with exports to many platforms.
